# Lekvya AI Automation & Transactional Email Platform

> Lekvya (developed by Navedhana) is a unified AI automation, transactional email infrastructure, and client communication platform serving Educational Institutions, Website Developers, Healthcare Clinics, E-Commerce, SaaS, and Chartered Accountants (CAs).

Website: https://lekvya.navedhana.com
Plans & Pricing: https://lekvya.navedhana.com/plan
Documentation: https://lekvya.navedhana.com/docs
Support: support@navedhana.com

## Core Value Proposition
Lekvya eliminates manual communication bottlenecks through automated client onboarding, intelligent bulk email scheduling, developer contact form APIs (EmailJS/Resend alternative), and pre-built multi-industry compliance workflows.

## Supported Industry Verticals & Presets

1. Educational Institutions & Academies (Schools, Colleges, Universities, Coaching)
   - Tuition & semester fee payment reminders (fee amount, due date, portal link)
   - Term & semester examination schedules, hall ticket release alerts
   - Faculty & Lecturer Council meeting notices
   - Invigilation & examination duty allocation rosters
   - Campus recruitment drives & placement alerts

2. Websites, Developers & APIs (EmailJS / Resend Alternative)
   - Public contact form submission API (`POST /api/v1/send-form` with `x-public-key`)
   - Instant visitor auto-responders & admin notifications
   - Transactional email API with Bearer token authentication
   - Real-time developer webhooks for delivery, bounces, and opens
   - 1x1 transparent GIF open-tracking pixel and click analytics

3. Healthcare Clinics & Medical Centers
   - 24-hour advance patient consultation and appointment reminders
   - Doctor schedule updates and clinic visit preparations
   - Secure laboratory test report readiness and portal download links

4. E-Commerce & Retail
   - Automated order confirmation receipts
   - Live shipment tracking alerts and courier status
   - Abandoned cart re-engagement sequences

5. SaaS & Technology Startups
   - Automated user onboarding drips
   - Passwordless magic login links
   - Trial ending warnings and subscription renewal invoices

6. Chartered Accountants (CAs) & Financial Firms
   - Statutory GST filing deadline alerts and GSTR reconciliation reminders
   - TDS return filing reminders and deductee sheet collection requests
   - Income Tax Return (ITR) filing deadlines and tax audit notifications
   - Client document submission portals

## Subscription Plans & Pricing (INR)

- Basic Plan (₹499 / month):
  - 7-Day Free Trial (No credit card required)
  - All 6 industry starter presets and merge variables
  - Client onboarding system & intake forms
  - Bulk email scheduler (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
  - Developer contact form API & auto-responders
  - Client document submission portal
  - Centralized analytics dashboard

- Pro Plan (₹699 / month) [Coming Soon / Waitlist]:
  - Everything in Basic
  - Unlimited custom templates & dynamic merge tags
  - Developer webhooks & event triggers
  - Real-time open & click tracking analytics
  - Priority email delivery queues
  - Client portal logins & team collaboration

- Premium Plan (₹999 / month) [Coming Soon / Waitlist]:
  - Everything in Pro
  - Custom sending domain verification (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  - 100% White-label portal & custom branding
  - Dedicated account manager & 24/7 SLA
  - Custom ERP / CRM / SIS integrations
  - Unlimited organization users & workspaces

## Security & Compliance
- AES-256 encryption at rest
- TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
- Multi-tenant organization isolation
- Strict anti-spam protections & suppression list management
